text_block_list.text:
Magnificently holding off Nishino Flower, 
Sakura Bakushin O conquered the Sprinters 
Stakes once again!

The Trainer showers her with endless 
praise after her consecutive victories on 
the grand stage!

Now that she has grown enough to win 
back-to-back victories in the Sprinters 
Stakes, she can take on 1,600m as well. 
The Trainer was convinced of this—

Stepping up the distance just a bit from 
sprints, it was decided to send her off to 
the Mile CS!
